name: Charge of the Heirs
summary: Every wide charge asks the die whether to heal or to strike.

face.name: Charge of the Heirs

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Each time Human Entities you control attack, roll a d20: on 1–6 you gain HP equal to the number of Human Entities that attacked this turn; on 15–20 the opposing Rubyfront/Nexus loses HP equal to the number of Human Entities that attacked this turn; on 7–14 nothing happens.

face.flavor: The count is kept afterwards, when the living are counted.
